services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: One thing people love most about beaches is pristine white sand. This is why it comes as no surprise that every year people flock Madeira Beach in Florida. A small seaside community along the beautiful waters of the Gulf of Mexico, Madeira Beach is surely a holiday destination that you and your family will love. Apart from its coast which boasts pristine white sand, Madeira beach also features a wide variety of restaurants as well as several watersport activities for the whole family. One activity that is surely fit for the entire family, the kids included, is boating. services.name: View kayaks
services.desc: Very few outdoor activities offer the same benefits, fun, and experience as kayaking. Whether you are in for a heart-pumping ride or the peace and serenity of being in the sea, kayaking will never let you down. In addition to being easy and enjoyable, kayaking is also good for your health. Whether you choose a few hours of fun or an all day outing, we have an adventure that’s perfect for you! Enjoy the Florida sun, sand and waves. Navigation is a breeze with our Garmin GPS system and depth finders to guide you on your way and keep you safe on intracoastal or Gulf waters. services.name: view paddle board
services.desc: Come with us on a paddleboard adventure and enjoy one of the fastest growing water sports in the world! Also known as a SUP (stand up paddleboard), our Liquid Shredder SUP boards are the biggest and the best boards in the industry. They are twelve feet long and four feet wide providing lots of stability. They can hold up to 300 pounds in total, so feel free to come alone or bring a friend. They also have anti-skid decks, so no shoes are required on our boards. The board’s core is built extra thick to allow for buoyancy.
